Rare and Legendary card art v1.0-cardart-B

Every Rare and Legendary card drawn in the approved Vignette direction, grouped by family. Each picture at 1x (Deck tile), 2x (opened card) and 3x (reward), with the card's rule and its evolution line, and once inside a Deck tile mock. Rare: far hills and a light source. Legendary: a stepped glow, a richer scene and a gold key-line.
